adopt: Point it at a backend you already pay for and run one agent loop.
description:
Kind: runtime

Problem
Running one agent is easy and running fifty is a different job: budgets, retries, which model, whose machine. Most frameworks make you adopt their whole world to find out.

Install
pip install awdk

Commands
  adk
  adk-awdelegate
  adk-bug
  adk-py
  adk-serve
  adk-shell
  adk-workspace
  aither-adk
  aither-hearth
  awdk

Quick start
  Any OS with Python 3.10+:

In Claude Code
  plugin                 awsh@awsh
  command                adk claude setup
  command                adk claude doctor
  mcp                    python -m adk.harnesses.mcp_stdio
  plugin                 aitheros
  command                adk antigravity setup
  command                adk antigravity doctor
  hook (PreToolUse)      python -S -m adk.harnesses.antigravity_hooks
  skill                  /awdk

Docs
https://aitherium.github.io/awdk/
